title: Bound desktop Review failure details with unconfirmed durable outcome
$comment: Native/client additionally limit UTF8 message<=1024B and diagnostic<=4096B, filter control characters except newline/tab, and require exact invocation request/job/operation. Only actual nonzero native stderr supplies diagnostic; success stderr is not an error. The last failing host phase/native observation is display context only. No retryable/not-committed/success flag, paths-as-authority, token, root, snapshot or replacement receipt. IPC pre-binding errors may remain legacy strings; invalid, lost, late and cancelled errors retain reload/no-auto-retry. Details are inert textContent, never HTML/URL/executable authority. No durable or worker schema changes.
